I visited Derma MD Hiranandani Estate for a skin consultation and Hydrafacial.

First, the positives: the consultation experience was excellent. The doctor was knowledgeable, patient, and reassuring. She reviewed my skincare routine, felt that I was already on the right track, and suggested a few additional products. I genuinely appreciated her advice and found the consultation worthwhile.

My disappointment was with the pricing transparency around the Hydrafacial.

Before booking, I had called multiple clinics to compare treatments and pricing. One of the reasons I chose Derma MD was because their Hydrafacial pricing seemed competitive.

However, after the consultation, once I was already inside the treatment room and about to begin the procedure, I was informed that the quoted Hydrafacial price was only for the face and that treating the neck would cost an additional ₹1,300. This information was never mentioned during my phone inquiry, booking, or consultation.

To be clear, my issue was not the additional cost itself. In fact, after leaving Derma MD, I visited another clinic in the same building and ultimately paid approximately the same amount (₹3,500) for a Hydrafacial. I was perfectly comfortable paying for the treatment.

My concern is that the full pricing structure should be disclosed upfront. Patients should know exactly what is included in the quoted price and what will be charged separately before they take the time to visit the clinic and make a decision.

The doctor consultation deserves praise, but the lack of transparency regarding the Hydrafacial pricing left me disappointed. Clear communication about inclusions and add-ons would significantly improve the overall patient experience.

I feel very disappointed and worried. Please do proper research and think twice before consulting this doctor. In my opinion, a responsible doctor should always consider a patient’s medical condition and history before prescribing such strong medication.
